author: reek
body: Stage 5b: multi-variable induction via nested `for all`. append-assoc quantifies three lists; induction runs on the NAMED scrutinee (as) while the other two binders (bs, cs) stay universally quantified as opaque constants through the proof. The MyCons case is `cong ih` (with the N-ary constructor peel). This exercises nested for-all binders and the checker selecting the induction variable by the scrutinee name.
